Rā Whakauru | Enrolment Day  

Kia rangatira te Tū!  
Saturday 29 November 2025 · 10:00am – 2:00pm  

Te Wānanga o Raukawa - Te Ara a Tāwhaki

41 Te Rauparaha Street, Ōtaki  


Ko te haerenga ki te ako, he haerenga hoki ki a koe anō.

﻿

Haere mai ki te Rā Whakauru, kia rewa ake tō reo, tō mana, tō whakapapa. Learning with us is a journey back to yourself. Join us at Enrolment Day; rekindle your language, your strength, your connection, your identity.


This is a day for our people who are ready to study and want support to take that first step.

entry.summary: Te Wānanga o Raukawa Ra Whakauru, Enrolment Day. Thinking of studying nextyear? Bring your whānau and get support enrolling, ID verified, view our campus and meet some of our pūkenga. Take a journey back to yourself through studies that will change your life, inspire your whānau and connect you to mātauranga Māori.
